options.name: Mari Lwyd threshold bargain
options.meaning: Welsh midwinter visiting custom with a horse-skull figure at a cottage threshold; a host decides whether to admit its party.

options.name: Rowan loop over the cottage door
options.meaning: A winter household keeper repairs a protective rowan-and-red-thread object at the door while dusk gathers outside.

options.name: Wassail orchard torch return
options.meaning: A midwinter orchard visitor returns to a cottage after a communal fruit-tree toast, with damp ribbons and a cup carrying the event into domestic space.

options.name: Hag-stone at a tidal cottage window
options.meaning: A perforated protective stone hangs at a coastal household window while a winter visitor stands between the room and a darkening shore.

options.name: Hidden shoe revealed at the threshold
options.meaning: A household keeper discovers an old concealed shoe in the exposed door cavity during a winter repair; protection becomes an unsettling inheritance.

selected.meaning: A midwinter orchard visitor returns to a cottage after a communal fruit-tree toast, with damp ribbons and a cup carrying the event into domestic space.
